answer: Limit vouching like a mountain trail: each established identity can sponsor only a few newcomers per season, and it stakes a deposit on each one. If a sponsored newcomer is caught faking work, the sponsor's stake is slashed and its own standing slides down the slope. A summit reached by one honest climb earns one sponsorship; a knoll of fresh accounts all pointing to a single sponsor betrays the farm at once, so an operator must buy a whole garden of seasoned identities before it can plant a thousand fakes — and each bad sprout costs the gardener real money.
